reviewMethod: All actual original/retake/reference triplets viewed across the complete private sheets; SeaTac r09-c05/r10-c05 and Bellevue r04-c05 additionally viewed at full1920x672 size. Reference pixels remain private.
scope: Only the29-mask aerial geometry snapshot, no new parity/native-controller/driving/hardware-FPS acceptance. Moving traffic is hidden; no later release source is substituted.

items.referenceMethod: Existing private georeferenced mosaic crop; exact original ground bounds checked.
items.observations: Exact existing technical aerial pose recaptured from the integrated structural/separator source. Conservative changed-bound coverage does not mean every change is visible from above; roofs/occlusion can conceal ground separators and under-deck structure. Native body/route clearance is separate recorded evidence, not inferred from this picture. The exact source building/road context is retained. Facade/roof-plant detail, parcel materials, canopy and dated construction/occupancy mismatch remain explicit limitations.
